decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued and the sales office and show flat demolished, and the hoardings removed, with the site restored in relation to application 01137/E/P52 on or before 07th September 2011 in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 2 - The office floor space and show flat contained within this proposal hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the marketing and sales of properties situated on the Former West Middlesex Hospital site and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 3 - No vehicular access shall be allowed from Park Road or Twickenham Road to the temporary sales site.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans APL001A Rev B, APL002A Rev B, APL003A Rev B submitted 15/09/2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Retention of a single storey detached temporary sales office.
